how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-rut-theran-village-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:978:obj:0: Collect 10 Moontouched Feathers from ⟦E1⟧, then return to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
rows.quest:978:details:0: Wildkin feathers from the Hinterlands appear to contain traces of magical qualities. These powers... they don't seem to be wielded by the creatures, it's more like they are simply inherent to the species -- part of their very essence.
rows.quest:978:details:1: BDuring my studies, I heard that a large population of wildkin inhabit the snowy lands of ⟦E1⟧. Could these creatures have the same powers? Please help me find an answer, ⟦1⟧. Go to ⟦E1⟧ and gather feathers that have dropped to the ground, then return to me.
rows.quest:978:completion:0: Now I can compare the feathers... Let's see...
rows.quest:979:details:0: Yes, yes, these feathers seem to hold the same magical enchantment that I noticed previously... While I am not certain what we might find, I urge you to continue searching for answers, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:979:details:1: BA colleague of mine recently traveled into ⟦E1⟧ to observe the wildkin there, in their own habitat. Why don't you catch up with her and see what she has found?
rows.quest:979:completion:0: Hi! Erelas sent you? Great, I was just preparing to travel up to the caves now, and I wouldn't mind company.
rows.quest:3661:obj:0: Collect 15 Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands for Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
rows.quest:3661:details:0: Wildkin are quite unpredictable creatures, ⟦3⟧. Capable of incredible gentleness, these creatures will show extreme ferocity if something they deem important is threatened.
rows.quest:3661:details:1: BThese beasts are rumored to have been created by ⟦E2⟧, and I am interested in finding if this is really the truth.
rows.quest:3661:details:2: BRecently, I heard about a population of wildkin living in the Hinterlands -- Vicious, Primitive, and Savage Owlbeasts. They can be found amongst the wildlife there. Will you gather some wildkin feathers for me?
rows.quest:3661:completion:0: Thank you for bringing these to me, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:3661:completion:1: BWhat did you learn of the Wildkin?
rows.quest:3661:completion:2: BPerhaps these feathers will tell us more. Ferocious monsters, or simply misguided pets? One day I'd like to know the truth...
rows.quest:3661:completion:3: BI am going to continue my research -- please come back and talk to me again after some time has passed.
rows.quest:5250:obj:0: Find Starfall in ⟦E1⟧ and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
rows.quest:5250:details:0: In ⟦E1⟧, to the north of ⟦E3⟧, there are many ancient elven ruins. It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore.
rows.quest:5250:details:1: BMy studies here keep me so busy that I have not had the opportunity to travel to ⟦E1⟧ for some time. But there's no reason why you shouldn't travel there and study the ruins.
rows.quest:5250:details:2: BWhile you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. He spends most of his time in Starfall and he knows a lot about the area.
rows.quest:5250:details:3: BTell him that you are a student of mine...
rows.quest:5250:completion:0: A student of Daryn Lightwind? Nice to meet you, ⟦5⟧.
